newsitem.title: USA: C.R. Bard wins $10.8 million in patent suit.
newsitem.headline: C.R. Bard wins $10.8 million in patent suit.

text.p: C.R. Bard Inc. said Tuesday a federal court jury awarded it $10.8 million in lost profits and other damages in a patent infringement suit against Boston Scientific Corp.
The jury determined an oesophageal dilation catheter sold by Boston Scientific's Microvasive Endoscopy division infringed a U.S. patent issued to Bard, the company said.
The catheters are used to treat strictures of the oesophagus resulting from acid reflux disease, oesophageal cancer and other causes, the Murray Hill, N.J.-based health products manufacturer said.
Boston Scientific officials and a C.R. Bard spokesman were not immediately available to elaborate on the suit.
C.R. Bard's stock was unchanged at $35.50, while Natick, Mass.-based Boston Scientific rose $1 to $59.875 on the New York Stock Exchange in early afternoon trading.
